newsitem.title: USA: Money market mutual fund assets down in last week of 1996.
newsitem.headline: Money market mutual fund assets down in last week of 1996.

text.p: Assets of the nation's 650 retail money market mutual funds fell $4.41 billion to $608.42 billion in the week ended Dec.31, the Investment Company Institute said Thursday.

The industry trade group said assets of the 395 taxable money market funds in the retail category fell $2.67 billion to $497.97 billion, while assets of the 255 tax-exempt funds fell $1.74 billion to $110.45 billion.

The institute said assets of the 316 institutional money market funds fell $10.21 billion to $290.17 billion. Of these, the 253 taxable money market fund assets fell $8.67 billion to $260.89 billion, while assets of the 63 tax-exempt funds fell $1.54 billion to $29.29 billion.
Money market mutual fund assets stood at $898.61 billion in the week. Assets in the week ended Dec. 24 were revised to $913.23 billion from $913.16 billion.
